Coram : ABHAY S. OKA*, AUGUSTINE GEORGE MASIH
Issue for Consideration Issue as regards sustainability of the order of conviction and sentence of the accused, when the case not proved beyond reasonable doubt against the accused. Headnotes† Penal Code, 1860 – ss. 302, 201 – Murder – Circumstantial evidence – Main 201 for murder of one lady during night, at the house of other accused – Other accused convicted and sentenced u/s. 201 – Prosecution case that motive for murder was illicit relation between the two accused – Order of conviction and sentence upheld by the High Court –
Decision Date : 05-11-2024 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 291/2023 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
